# 关联图：只把用户提供的数值矩阵绘制为载荷矩阵、相关性矩阵或交互网络图
import io
import base64
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.cm import ScalarMappable
from matplotlib.colors import LinearSegmentedColormap, Normalize
from matplotlib.collections import LineCollection
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patches import Circle, Ellipse, Rectangle

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'sans-serif',
    'font.sans-serif': ['Microsoft YaHei', 'SimHei', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'],
    'axes.unicode_minus': False,
    'font.size': 10,
    'axes.titlesize': 15,
    'xtick.labelsize': 9,
    'ytick.labelsize': 9,
    'figure.facecolor': 'white',
    'axes.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.facecolor': 'white',
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
})

SIGNED_CMAP = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('signed_deep', ['#174A7E', '#F7F8FA', '#B62935'])
UNSIGNED_CMAP = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('unsigned_blue', ['#F4F8FC', '#8FB9D9', '#164F8C'])
CORRELATION_SIGNED_CMAP = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('correlation_signed_vivid', [
    (0.00, '#0B4F8A'),
    (0.46, '#8DB7D9'),
    (0.50, '#F7F8FA'),
    (0.54, '#E99A91'),
    (1.00, '#C51F2D'),
])
CORRELATION_UNSIGNED_CMAP = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list('correlation_unsigned_vivid', [
    (0.00, '#EAF1F8'),
    (0.10, '#BFD8ED'),
    (1.00, '#0B4F8A'),
])
NODE_IMPORTANCE_CMAP = LinearSegmentedColormap.from_list(
    'node_importance', ['#FFF4C2', '#F6C744', '#E67E22']
)
TEXT = '#28323C'
GRID = '#B8C0C8'
image_types = {{image_types}}
weight_range = {{weight_range}}


def _to_frame(value):
    if isinstance(value, pd.DataFrame):
        return value.copy()
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        for encoding in ('utf-8-sig', 'utf-8', 'gbk', 'gb18030'):
            try:
                return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.decode(encoding)))
            except UnicodeDecodeError:
                continue
        raise RuntimeError('CSV 编码无法识别')
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(value.lstrip('\ufeff')))
    raise RuntimeError('输入 data 必须是 CSV 文本或 DataFrame')


def _to_png(fig):
    buffer = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buffer, format='png', dpi=300, facecolor='white', bbox_inches=None)
    plt.close(fig)
    return 'data:image/png;base64,' + base64.b64encode(buffer.getvalue()).decode('ascii')


def _colors():
    if weight_range == '1~-1':
        return SIGNED_CMAP, Normalize(vmin=-1, vmax=1), '权重（-1 到 1）'
    return UNSIGNED_CMAP, Normalize(vmin=0, vmax=1), '权重（0 到 1）'


def _matrix_axes(ax, rows, columns):
    n_rows, n_columns = len(rows), len(columns)
    ax.set_xlim(-0.5, n_columns - 0.5)
    ax.set_ylim(n_rows - 0.5, -0.5)
    ax.set_aspect('equal')
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(n_columns))
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(n_rows))
    ax.set_xticklabels(columns, rotation=38, ha='left', rotation_mode='anchor')
    ax.xaxis.tick_top()
    ax.tick_params(axis='x', pad=8, length=0)
    ax.set_yticklabels(rows)
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', length=0)
    ax.set_xticks(np.arange(-0.5, n_columns, 1), minor=True)
    ax.set_yticks(np.arange(-0.5, n_rows, 1), minor=True)
    ax.grid(which='minor', color=GRID, linewidth=0.75)
    ax.tick_params(which='minor', bottom=False, left=False)
    for spine in ax.spines.values():
        spine.set_color('#68737E')
        spine.set_linewidth(0.9)


def _add_colorbar(fig, ax, cmap, norm, label):
    mapper = ScalarMappable(norm=norm, cmap=cmap)
    mapper.set_array([])
    colorbar = fig.colorbar(mapper, ax=ax, fraction=0.045, pad=0.055, shrink=0.82)
    colorbar.set_label(label)
    return colorbar


def _load_matrix(values, row_labels, column_labels, cmap, norm, colorbar_label):
    n_rows, n_columns = values.shape
    size = max(6.6, min(15.5, 2.4 + 0.52 * max(n_rows, n_columns)))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(size + 1.0, max(5.6, size * n_rows / max(1, n_columns) * 0.88)), facecolor='white')
    _matrix_axes(ax, row_labels, column_labels)
    xs, ys, weights = [], [], []
    for row in range(n_rows):
        for column in range(n_columns):
            value = float(values[row, column])
            if not np.isfinite(value):
                continue
            xs.append(column)
            ys.append(row)
            weights.append(value)
    weights = np.asarray(weights)
    sizes = 50 + 680 * np.abs(weights)
    ax.scatter(xs, ys, s=sizes, c=weights, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, marker='o', edgecolor='#FFFFFF', linewidth=0.75, zorder=2)
    font_size = max(5.8, min(9.0, 12.0 - 0.24 * max(n_rows, n_columns)))
    for x, y, value in zip(xs, ys, weights):
        color = 'white' if abs(float(value)) >= 0.58 else TEXT
        ax.text(x, y, f'{float(value):.2f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=font_size, fontweight='bold', color=color, zorder=3)
    fig.suptitle('载荷矩阵', x=0.075, y=0.965, ha='left', fontweight='bold', color=TEXT)
    _add_colorbar(fig, ax, cmap, norm, colorbar_label)
    fig.text(0.075, 0.025, f'直接绘制输入矩阵：{n_rows} × {n_columns}；圆越大表示 |权重| 越大。', fontsize=8.5, color='#66707A')
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.15, right=0.88, top=0.86, bottom=0.10)
    return fig


def _correlation_matrix(values, labels, cmap, norm, colorbar_label):
    count = len(labels)
    display_cmap = CORRELATION_SIGNED_CMAP if weight_range == '1~-1' else CORRELATION_UNSIGNED_CMAP
    size = max(7.0, min(15.5, 2.7 + count * 0.62))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(size + 1.1, size), facecolor='white')
    _matrix_axes(ax, labels, labels)
    font_size = max(6.0, min(10.0, 12.0 - 0.27 * count))
    diagonal_indexes = [index for index in range(count) if np.isfinite(values[index, index])]
    if diagonal_indexes:
        diagonal_values = np.asarray([float(values[index, index]) for index in diagonal_indexes])
        diagonal_sizes = 90 + 980 * np.abs(diagonal_values)
        ax.scatter(
            diagonal_indexes, diagonal_indexes, s=diagonal_sizes,
            c=diagonal_values, cmap=display_cmap, norm=norm,
            marker='o', edgecolor='#FFFFFF', linewidth=0.75, zorder=2,
        )
        for index, value in zip(diagonal_indexes, diagonal_values):
            number_color = 'white' if abs(float(value)) >= 0.58 else TEXT
            ax.text(index, index, f'{float(value):.2f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=font_size, fontweight='bold', color=number_color, zorder=3)
    for row in range(count):
        for column in range(count):
            if row == column:
                continue
            value = float(values[row, column])
            color = display_cmap(norm(value))
            if row < column:
                ax.add_patch(Rectangle(
                    (column - 0.5, row - 0.5), 1.0, 1.0,
                    facecolor=color, edgecolor='#FFFFFF', linewidth=1.0, zorder=1,
                ))
                number_color = 'white' if abs(value) >= 0.50 else TEXT
                ax.text(column, row, f'{value:.2f}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=font_size, fontweight='bold', color=number_color, zorder=3)
            else:
                strength = abs(value)
                minor_axis = max(0.08, 0.78 * (1.0 - strength) ** 0.72)
                angle = 45 if value >= 0 else -45
                ellipse = Ellipse((column, row), width=0.78, height=minor_axis, angle=angle, facecolor=color, edgecolor='#6F7881', linewidth=0.75, alpha=0.96, zorder=2)
                ax.add_patch(ellipse)
    fig.suptitle('相关性矩阵', x=0.075, y=0.965, ha='left', fontweight='bold', color=TEXT)
    _add_colorbar(fig, ax, display_cmap, norm, colorbar_label)
    fig.text(0.075, 0.025, '上三角以填色方格显示数值；下三角显示椭圆；CSV 对角线有数字时绘制载荷圆，空白时留空。', fontsize=8.5, color='#66707A')
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.15, right=0.88, top=0.86, bottom=0.10)
    return fig


def _interaction_network(values, labels, cmap, norm, colorbar_label):
    count = len(labels)
    fig_size = max(7.4, min(12.5, 5.8 + count * 0.32))
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(fig_size + 1.4, fig_size), facecolor='white')
    angles = np.pi / 2 - np.arange(count) * 2 * np.pi / count
    positions = np.column_stack([np.cos(angles), np.sin(angles)])
    ax.add_patch(Circle((0, 0), radius=1.0, fill=False, edgecolor='#E7C77B', linewidth=2.0, alpha=0.92, zorder=0))
    segments, widths, colors = [], [], []
    importance = np.zeros(count, dtype=float)
    for left in range(count):
        for right in range(left + 1, count):
            value = float(values[left, right])
            strength = abs(value)
            importance[left] += strength
            importance[right] += strength
            if strength <= 1e-12:
                continue
            segments.append([positions[left], positions[right]])
            widths.append(0.35 + 2.35 * strength)
            rgba = list(cmap(norm(value)))
            rgba[3] = 0.12 + 0.78 * strength
            colors.append(rgba)
    if segments:
        ax.add_collection(LineCollection(segments, colors=colors, linewidths=widths, zorder=1, capstyle='round'))
    node_sizes = np.full(count, max(430.0, 760.0 - count * 15.0))
    minimum_importance, maximum_importance = float(importance.min()), float(importance.max())
    if np.isclose(minimum_importance, maximum_importance):
        importance_norm = Normalize(vmin=minimum_importance - 0.5, vmax=maximum_importance + 0.5)
    else:
        importance_norm = Normalize(vmin=minimum_importance, vmax=maximum_importance)
    ax.scatter(positions[:, 0], positions[:, 1], s=node_sizes, c=importance, cmap=NODE_IMPORTANCE_CMAP, norm=importance_norm, edgecolor='#FFFFFF', linewidth=1.8, zorder=3)
    ax.scatter(positions[:, 0], positions[:, 1], s=node_sizes, facecolors='none', edgecolor='#44515C', linewidth=0.85, zorder=4)
    for index, (x, y) in enumerate(positions):
        radius = 1.18
        label_x, label_y = x * radius, y * radius
        horizontal = 'left' if x > 0.15 else ('right' if x < -0.15 else 'center')
        vertical = 'bottom' if y > 0.15 else ('top' if y < -0.15 else 'center')
        ax.text(label_x, label_y, str(labels[index]), ha=horizontal, va=vertical, fontsize=9.2, color=TEXT, fontweight='bold')
    ax.set_xlim(-1.46, 1.46)
    ax.set_ylim(-1.36, 1.36)
    ax.set_aspect('equal')
    ax.axis('off')
    fig.suptitle('交互网络图', x=0.075, y=0.965, ha='left', fontweight='bold', color=TEXT)
    _add_colorbar(fig, ax, cmap, norm, colorbar_label)
    legend = [
        Line2D([0], [0], color='#6D7882', linewidth=0.35 + 2.35 * strength, alpha=0.12 + 0.78 * strength, label=f'|权重| = {strength:.2g}')
        for strength in (0.25, 0.60, 1.00)
    ]
    edge_legend = ax.legend(handles=legend, frameon=False, loc='lower center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.06), ncol=3, title='边：线宽与深浅')
    ax.add_artist(edge_legend)
    node_legend = [
        Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', linestyle='none', markerfacecolor=NODE_IMPORTANCE_CMAP(level), markeredgecolor='#6F5C2E', markersize=8, label=label)
        for level, label in ((0.0, '低'), (0.5, '中'), (1.0, '高'))
    ]
    ax.legend(handles=node_legend, frameon=False, loc='lower center', bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.17), ncol=3, title='节点：关联重要性')
    fig.text(0.075, 0.025, '节点位于圆环上；节点越偏橙表示所连边的 |权重| 之和越大；边仅读取矩阵上三角。', fontsize=8.5, color='#66707A')
    fig.subplots_adjust(left=0.08, right=0.86, top=0.90, bottom=0.20)
    return fig


if data is None:
    raise RuntimeError('请先连接并运行上游的数据导入插件')
if not isinstance(image_types, (list, tuple)) or not image_types:
    raise RuntimeError('请至少选择一种图片类型')
allowed_types = ('载荷矩阵', '相关性矩阵', '交互网络图')
if any(item not in allowed_types for item in image_types):
    raise RuntimeError('图片类型只能多选：载荷矩阵、相关性矩阵、交互网络图')
if weight_range not in ('1~-1', '1-0'):
    raise RuntimeError('权重范围只能选择“1~-1”或“1-0”')

frame = _to_frame(data)
if frame.empty or frame.shape[1] == 0:
    raise RuntimeError('输入 CSV 是空矩阵')
numeric = frame.apply(pd.to_numeric, errors='coerce')
blank_mask = frame.isna().copy()
for column in frame.columns:
    blank_mask[column] = blank_mask[column] | frame[column].astype('string').str.strip().eq('').fillna(False)
invalid_mask = numeric.isna() & ~blank_mask
if invalid_mask.any().any():
    bad_count = int(invalid_mask.sum().sum())
    raise RuntimeError(f'输入矩阵发现 {bad_count} 个非数字内容；仅方阵对角线允许留空')
missing_positions = np.argwhere(numeric.isna().to_numpy())
if len(missing_positions) and (
    numeric.shape[0] != numeric.shape[1]
    or any(int(row) != int(column) for row, column in missing_positions)
):
    raise RuntimeError('输入矩阵只有方阵对角线可以留空；其他格子必须都有数字')
values = numeric.to_numpy(dtype=float)
if np.isinf(values).any():
    raise RuntimeError('输入矩阵不能包含无穷大或无效数字')
finite_values = values[np.isfinite(values)]
if finite_values.size == 0:
    raise RuntimeError('输入矩阵没有可绘制的数字')
minimum, maximum = float(finite_values.min()), float(finite_values.max())
if weight_range == '1~-1' and (minimum < -1 or maximum > 1):
    raise RuntimeError(f'权重范围选择 1~-1 时，所有数字必须位于 [-1, 1]；当前范围为 [{minimum:.3g}, {maximum:.3g}]')
if weight_range == '1-0' and (minimum < 0 or maximum > 1):
    raise RuntimeError(f'权重范围选择 1-0 时，所有数字必须位于 [0, 1]；当前范围为 [{minimum:.3g}, {maximum:.3g}]')
if values.shape[0] > 30 or values.shape[1] > 30:
    raise RuntimeError('为保证图片可读性，输入矩阵最多支持 30 行 × 30 列')

column_labels = [str(column) for column in frame.columns]
row_labels = column_labels if values.shape[0] == values.shape[1] else [f'行{index + 1}' for index in range(values.shape[0])]
requires_square = any(item in ('相关性矩阵', '交互网络图') for item in image_types)
if requires_square and values.shape[0] != values.shape[1]:
    raise RuntimeError('相关性矩阵和交互网络图要求输入为 n × n 方阵；载荷矩阵可以使用 n × m 矩阵')
if '交互网络图' in image_types and values.shape[0] > 20:
    raise RuntimeError('为保证交互网络图标签可读性，网络图最多支持 20 个节点')

cmap, norm, colorbar_label = _colors()
images = []
for image_type in image_types:
    if image_type == '载荷矩阵':
        figure = _load_matrix(values, row_labels, column_labels, cmap, norm, colorbar_label)
    elif image_type == '相关性矩阵':
        figure = _correlation_matrix(values, column_labels, cmap, norm, colorbar_label)
    else:
        figure = _interaction_network(values, column_labels, cmap, norm, colorbar_label)
    images.append(_to_png(figure))

return {'image': images[0] if len(images) == 1 else images}
name: 关联图

params.hint: 多选时，唯一的 image 节点会按选择顺序输出多张图片。
params.label: 图片类型（多选）

params.hint: 1~-1 使用红—蓝发散色；1-0 使用由浅到深的蓝色。
params.label: 权重范围

description: 直接绘制数值 CSV 矩阵；相关性矩阵上三角为热力格，对角线有值时显示载荷圆、留空时不补值，并支持圆环网络。
masterEvidence: 直接绘制输入矩阵，不执行相关性计算或补值
对角线数字使用加大载荷圆、空白保持为空；上三角热力格、下三角椭圆与圆环网络
